name: TSPred
description: A toolkit of functions to facilitate benchmarking time-series prediction models, providing utilities for dataset handling, evaluation metrics, and experimental workflows.
evaluation_method: standard forecasting metrics (MSE / RMSE / MAE / MAPE)
reputation: A practical CRAN toolkit used by researchers and practitioners for standardized time-series evaluation and experiment management; modest adoption in the forecasting community.
notes: Toolkit rather than a single dataset—no single SOTA; results depend on chosen datasets and models; supports many common forecasting metrics and workflows.
